title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
summary: A shy Mole meets Water Rat on a riverbank and is drawn into a world of picnics, boats and the boastful, accident-prone Mr Toad, with mild trouble waiting in the wild wood.
readIf: you want a lazy, comforting read full of rivers, friendship and good food.
skipIf: you want modern pacing or complex plots.

pairings.reason: Another gentle, cosy collection about animal friends and small adventures.
A livelier animal adventure with feasting, swordplay and heroes.
A modern cosy tale with the same comfort-of-friends feel for adult readers.
